description: Public edition: Coordinates surveying, architecture, material production, robotics, utilities, and inspection to build infrastructure at scale.
body:
Automated City Construction Civilization. Coordinates surveying, architecture, material production, robotics, utilities, and inspection to build infrastructure at scale.

This database covers the technology as item 211 entry 81 of Manon's "100 Ultra-Advanced Future Technologies" catalog, section "Megastructures and Planetary Transformation". It is the public edition: every factual claim below is drawn from real public science and engineering, honestly labeled.

Feasibility tier: experimentally supported. Construction automation is advancing (3D-printed buildings, robotic bricklaying); full civilization-scale coordination is unproven.

Classification: public database. This record profiles the technology; companion records cover known science, constraints, approaches, tools, unresolved problems, evidence, and outlook.

title: Automated City Construction Civilization - Known Science Foundations
description: Public edition: Coordinates surveying, architecture, material production, robotics, utilities, and inspection to build infrastructure at scale.
body:
Known science foundations of Automated City Construction Civilization.

3D-printed houses are commercial (ICON). Robotic bricklayers (SAM) work on sites. Autonomous earthmovers operate in mines. BIM coordinates design. Prefab modular construction scales. Coordinating all of it as one automated civilization — surveying to inspection — remains conceptual.

Key quantity check (3D-printed houses completed / houses built conventionally per year in millions): computed ratio 0.0005 against the reference value, relative error 0, within the stated tolerance of 0.5. This calculation was executed in Node.js at build time and the output stored verbatim.

Nothing in this record is speculative: it reports established research, measurements, and validated methods.

title: Automated City Construction Civilization - Physical and Engineering Constraints
description: Public edition: Coordinates surveying, architecture, material production, robotics, utilities, and inspection to build infrastructure at scale.
body:
Physical and engineering constraints on Automated City Construction Civilization.

Construction sites are unstructured and variable. Regulation and inspection assume human builders. Coordinating trades robotically is unsolved.

Scale analysis across 3 quantities spans 5.6 orders of magnitude; the dominant scale separation is conventional builds vs build time reduction at 5.6 orders of magnitude (conventional builds larger). Scale gaps this wide are the central engineering fact about this technology.

Unresolved problems for Automated City Construction Civilization, in priority order (research burden index 24, 2 blocking):

Unstructured site autonomy (severity 3/3, tractability 2/3, BLOCKING; priority 9).

Full-stack coordination (severity 3/3, tractability 2/3, BLOCKING; priority 9).

Regulatory acceptance (severity 2/3, tractability 1/3; priority 6).

These are open problems, stated plainly. A technology with unresolved blocking problems is not ready, whatever its promise.
